config.label: Your alchm
config.description: Your alchm.kitchen API key — mint one at https://alchm.kitchen/profile/api-keys. Optional; unlocks per-user quotas and invocation telemetry. The server runs anonymously without it.

config.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Optional; enables the token gate and invocation logging. Omit for anonymous mode (all tools still function).
